title: Build a boosted model
description: Course activity for Exercise 7: follow squared-error gradient boosting one shallow tree at a time on a small simulated dataset.
instructions: Choose a learning rate, then step through the boosting stages with the slider or the Previous/Next buttons. The top panel shows the observed points and the current ensemble prediction; the middle panel shows the residuals left before this update and the shallow tree fitted to them; the bottom panel shows training MSE across every stage, with the current stage highlighted.
reflectionPrompts: What does the model predict before adding a tree?
Does the new tree predict age directly or the current residuals?
What changes when the learning rate decreases?
Why does a smaller learning rate usually require more trees?
Can training error continue falling after the model has started overfitting?
